findings.detail: This is a close copy of sample question 2. Both use scenario 1 with the same tools: lookup_order has a minimal description and the agent confuses it with get_customer. Both have the same correct action in option C: expand the tool description with input formats, examples, edge cases and boundaries versus similar tools. The added input-format failure does not change the scene or the action enough.

blind_answer.reason: Tool descriptions are the main way the model picks a tool and formats its input. Spelling out the ORD-##### format with an example, plus the rule that email-only requests go through get_customer first, fixes both the bad inputs and the wrong routing. Renaming alone (A) leaves the format unexplained. A keyword rule (B) makes the misrouting worse. Forcing get_customer on every turn (D) is too blunt and breaks the normal flow.
